cmd:
bash -c 'D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
echo "--- ls"; ls $D | head -60; echo "--- pairs.json"; cat $D/pairs.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 400; echo
echo "--- config.json"; python3 - <<'\''PY'\''
import json
c=json.load(open('\''/opt/trading-bot/classic/config.json'\''))
print(json.dumps(c,ensure_ascii=False)[:1800])
PY
echo "--- hand.json"; python3 - <<'\''PY'\''
import json
try:
    h=json.load(open('\''/opt/trading-bot/classic/hand.json'\''))
    print(type(h).__name__, len(h)); print(str(h)[:500])
except Exception as e: print("hand err",e)
PY
echo "--- env"; PY=/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python; [ -x $PY ] || PY=python3; echo $PY; $PY -c "import numpy,pandas,aiohttp;print('\''np'\'',numpy.__version__,'\''pd'\'',pandas.__version__)" 2>&1 | tail -1; nproc; free -m | sed -n 2p; df -h /opt | tail -1
systemctl cat classicbot 2>/dev/null | grep -i "ExecStart\|WorkingDir\|Environment"
'
